project_name: JPNS Enterprises LLC Luxury Marketing Website Restyle Blueprint

design_archetype.vibe: Cinematic, dark luxury, royal purple warmth, metallic gold prestige, authoritative editorial
design_archetype.description: Restyling the JPNS Enterprises homepage to perfectly mirror the reference mockup: vivid royal purple gradient hero background, giant Playfair Display serif headline with metallic gold italic accent, dual gold buttons, founder Jewell Proby Shine signature framed hero visual, and 5 distinct rounded gold-bordered division cards in a single row.

hierarchy.h1_accent_word: font-serif italic text-gold gold-shimmer block sm:inline font-normal

hero_section_spec.background_decorations: Radial spotlight glow at upper right (radial-gradient(circle, rgba(107,31,175,0.5) 0%, transparent 70%)), fine subtle grain overlay (.grain class), and ambient gold sparkle accents
hero_section_spec.headline_styling: Strength. Vision. Legacy.
hero_section_spec.subheading_text: A diversified private holdings ecosystem driving excellence across luxury self-care, entertainment, culinary arts, exotic rentals, and strategic philanthropy.

transition_to_lower_sections.cohesion_rule: Maintain thin gold borders (border-gold/20), Playfair Display headings, Montserrat body, and subtle radial purple glow under key section cards so lower content flows seamlessly from the royal purple hero.

component_guidelines.header_nav: Fixed top z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#140321]/80 border-b border-gold/20 px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between
component_guidelines.interactive_inputs: Use .lux-input utility with underline gold highlight on focus; mandatory label and data-testid attributes
component_guidelines.toasts: Sonner toasts with gold border and dark purple background for actions like contact form submit and cart add

testing_attributes.mandatory_rule: Every interactive button, link, division card, input, and hero callout MUST include explicit role-based data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-headline', data-testid='explore-divisions-btn', data-testid='division-card-01-self-care').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT alter or rebuild existing pages (/about, /divisions, /shop, /impact, /contact, /partner) or Stripe checkout logic - this is a homepage restyle & enhancement.
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds on sticky nav or dropdown menus; always use glassmorphism with backdrop blur and explicit subtle background color (e.g. bg-[#140321]/80 backdrop-blur-xl).
Do NOT exceed text-6xl for hero headings; keep typography hierarchy crisp and proportional.
Do NOT use generic sans fonts for main headlines; keep Playfair Display for headings and Montserrat for body text.
Ensure founder visual uses /jewell-sitting.jpg and script/serif gold signature overlay 'Jewell Proby Shine / Founder & CEO'.
Maintain exact division order: 01 Self-Care, 02 Events & Entertainment, 03 Restaurant Chains, 04 Luxury Car Rentals, 05 Philanthropy.
All codebase files are standard React JavaScript (.js/.jsx) files - do NOT produce TypeScript (.tsx) references.
Ensure data-testid attributes are present on every interactive and key text element.
